verdict.rationale: Cline runs entirely on the user's own machine: it installs locally via npm or as an IDE extension, has a public GitHub repo, and the pricing page states you can "switch providers or self-host anytime." It supports BYOK and local model runtimes (Ollama, LM Studio), and one community user confirms local models work well, though another reports Ollama works poorly with most models. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license or self-hosting deployment guide, documentation of self-hosting any Cline-hosted services (hub, account, provider), and consistent independent confirmation of fully local operation.
